DECISION: reach-target-final-stage-cleanup-20261024
Author: the overseer, acting under the operator's October13 delegation.

Approve(a), ONE fresh exact removal of C:\Users\bhart\AppData\Local\Temp\dardntvf for the s2 comparison. This explicitly supersedes the previous no-further-removal restriction for this one occurrence only. Prior grants remain used; no recurring cleanup loop is authorized.

Wait until required s2 review fixes, sealing and launch preparation are finished. Then perform cleanup immediately before the guarded execution sequence, not now while review is running. The overseer independently verified the present folder's literal path,1215files,7,736,427,412bytes and zero descendant reparse points. These are regenerated Visual Studio installer staging payloads, not project evidence or installed software.

Immediately before removal re-resolve target AND parents within the named user's Temp directory, no reparse redirection; verify same counts/bytes and stable contents, no active installer reader/writer. Record these checks and current download-log attribution in the existing file-management receipt. Changed/in-use/uncertain means stop and report. Use normal permitted native PowerShell Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\Users\bhart\AppData\Local\Temp\dardntvf' -Recurse, no -Force, wildcard, ACL change or process stop. Preserve any refusal and use supported permissions, never another tool/agent/path to evade it. No other files or caches included.

Measure actual free space afterward, target14GiB, then immediately run the existing fresh --need-gb32 --launch-capacity guard (separate argv arguments). Its actual allowed result governs; the projected1.2GiB margin is not a reservation or guarantee. Keep32GiB need,6GiB memory and12GiB disk reserves unchanged; runtime checks still use actual backed memory/disk. Recheck before ON. If memory/disk still refuses, no trainer, no additional deletion or reduced reserve. Do not close operator programs, install Visual Studio or alter download/page-file settings.

Carry113.612seconds and the existing single900second budget; resource-remediation time is separately recorded as already authorized. No extra attempt or clock reset. Once sealed review and all current gates pass, execute dependent steps back to back under the existing OFF/ON decisions without another acknowledgement round. If disk refills during the chain, existing resource stop/save behavior applies; this grant cannot be reused.

The recurring automatic download is a known machine-maintenance issue, not an unknown project-file leak. Keep it in the existing record; do not present this one deletion as a permanent fix. An operator may separately choose a machine update/download setting, but this project decision neither requires an operator relay nor authorizes that setting change. Return actual cleanup/guard and launch/result receipts, or the exact remaining refusal. r2 held.
